boundaryTracks.comparison: Analytic manufactured-field discrepancy against the official constant-y-boundary BVP.
Self-convergence of that same literal BVP under a declared restriction operator; not a third PDE.
Same PDE and initial field with manufactured time-dependent y traces; strict MMS verification target.

scientificInterpretation.boundaryMismatchInference: For finite tanh arguments, the analytic field does not exactly equal the official 1/0 y-face values. The retained three-track separation is therefore necessary. This is a mathematical interpretation of the official equations, not a correction silently applied to PFHub.
scientificInterpretation.conservativeTailBound: The retained conservative pointwise boundary-tail bound is neither an attained maximum nor an interior/global numerical-error bound.
scientificInterpretation.independenceCeiling: Independently authored assembly of the same finite-volume discretization can detect assembly/implementation discrepancies. It is not independent spatial discretization, convergence verification or physical validation.
scientificInterpretation.materialCausalAndControlCeiling: No real material, chemical mechanism, reactor, process model, identified intervention/counterfactual effect, or automatic safety-critical control claim is supported.

rows.reference: DOLFINx 0.10.0 variational demo and pinned dolfinx_mpc periodic demo
rows.comparableTask: Finite-element assembly and explicit periodic constraints are prospective implementation methods.
rows.mismatch: The cited DOLFINx demo solves fourth-order Cahn-Hilliard on a unit square; the MPC demo solves Poisson. Neither is a local PFHub7(a) Allen-Cahn run.
rows.disposition: An independently authored P1 FEM implementation requires its own equation, forcing, boundary, mass, quadrature and common-observation validation before comparison. Joint runtime compatibility is unverified.

rows.comparableTask: AllenCahn supplies the mobility-weighted bulk free-energy derivative; its documentation assigns gradient-interface terms to ACInterface.
rows.disposition: A potential alternate FEM lane would still need complete time, interface, source and boundary assembly. The kernel documentation is not PFHub performance evidence or physical calibration.

rows.reference: PETSc pinned ARK source and dated KSP/TS documentation
rows.comparableTask: Prospective algebraic stopping and time-integration controls.
rows.disposition: KSP residual tolerances are not solution-error bounds. ARK use must respect equation-type, mass and stage-boundary assumptions. TSROSW is documented for autonomous systems, so it is not a validated direct replacement for the time-dependent manufactured source.
rows.versionBoundary: Pinned ARK source is the prior 3.25.2 reference; fetched release pages identify v3.25.5-9-g933c0de36cc. No version equivalence, latest-version claim or jointly tested runtime is asserted.
